searchText: https://etherscan.io/tx/0xd4ec6a0b8129ff6c64ac34ddd82184cdcf174166ffa8570c69cb79a2f8fcf739 stuck again incase you want to check it out Only problem with those transactions was that the base fee was too low so you had to wait for it to drop down before your transactions could be included. What I think happened was that it was high enough for some of them to get through into the block but others at the same gas that were pushed didn’t and then gas rose https://etherscan.io/tx/0x42459cbb57a07ba821f478c4125421194f83cd9c7539be8daddc60027ac66ba8 was where things stalled. Once the base fee dropped back low enough to include this the rest sent through pretty quickly. Yep It works but also so many complaints everytime it happebs Looks like the txs are being sent with the current base fee as the max fee, which gives no leeway in the case of base fee rising. Consider setting max base fee to be the current base fee + 30% or similar. (But this is now way off-topic for this discord so I'll shut up)
